integrity: Proof and finite standard-library verifier included. Published general algorithms and the published area-only polygon formula are explicitly credited. No claim of external or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Requires a convex, centrally symmetric cyclic polygon; no theorem for irregular radii, odd polygons, or prescribed rectangle aspect ratio. General convex-polygon algorithms already exist. An unindexed equivalent chord argument remains a historical priority risk. All-dimensional claim follows from analytic proof; finite diagnostics are supplementary.
title: Maximum-perimeter rectangles in centrally symmetric cyclic polygons
